--- title: "Model 4 — Elastic Net" subtitle: "Penalised linear regression via glmnet — interpretable baseline" --- > **Where we are:** Fourth of six model documents in the > [House Prices — Tidymodels Tour](../index.qmd). Same structure as the others; > we model `log(SalePrice)` and score on RMSE. ## Why elastic net? A regularised linear model is the classic, interpretable regression baseline — and on the log scale, with the Yeo-Johnson-transformed features from the recipe, it is genuinely competitive on Ames. `glmnet` blends **ridge** (L2) and **lasso** (L1) penalties: `penalty` sets the total shrinkage and `mixture` the L1/L2 balance (1 = pure lasso, 0 = pure ridge). Lasso also does automatic feature selection, which is handy given ~200 dummy columns. ## Setup ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source(here::here("R", "00_setup.R")) source(here("R", "02_features.R")) library(tidyverse) library(tidymodels) library(here) library(vip) library(glmnet) # the engine ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} train <- readr::read_csv(here("data", "processed", "train.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(SalePrice = log(SalePrice)) ``` ::: ## Recipe, spec, workflow ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} en_recipe <- make_recipe(train) en_spec <- linear_reg( penalty = tune(), mixture = tune() ) |> set_engine("glmnet") |> set_mode("regression") en_wf <- workflow() |> add_recipe(en_recipe) |> add_model(en_spec) ``` ::: ## Tuning with 10-fold cross-validation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(42) folds <- vfold_cv(train, v = 10, strata = SalePrice) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} preds <- prep(make_recipe(train, num_comp = 2)) |> bake(new_data = NULL) |> select(-SalePrice, -Id) en_params <- extract_parameter_set_dials(en_wf) |> finalize(preds) |> update(num_comp = num_comp(range = c(2L, 15L))) set.seed(42) en_grid <- grid_space_filling(en_params, size = 20) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} en_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq) set.seed(42) en_tuned <- tune_grid( en_wf, resamples = folds, grid = en_grid, metrics = en_metrics, control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE, save_workflow = TRUE) ) saveRDS(en_tuned, here("models", "elasticnet_res.rds")) ``` ::: ### Tuning results ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} autoplot(en_tuned, metric = "rmse") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![RMSE across the tuning grid (autoplot).](06-elasticnet_files/figure-html/tune-plot-1.png){width=864} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} show_best(en_tuned, metric = "rmse", n = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Finalize and fit ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} best_en <- select_best(en_tuned, metric = "rmse") best_en ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} final_en_wf <- finalize_workflow(en_wf, best_en) set.seed(42) en_fit <- fit(final_en_wf, data = train) ``` ::: ## Cross-validated performance ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} collect_metrics(en_tuned) |> semi_join(best_en, by = names(best_en)) |> select(.metric, mean, std_err, n) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ### Observed vs predicted (out-of-fold) ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} collect_predictions(en_tuned) |> filter(.config == best_en$.config) |> ggplot(aes(x = SalePrice, y = .pred)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linetype = 2) + geom_point(alpha = 0.35, colour = house_pal[4]) + labs(title = "Elastic Net — CV predicted vs observed", x = "Observed log(SalePrice)", y = "Predicted log(SalePrice)") + coord_equal() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Out-of-fold predicted vs observed log(SalePrice).](06-elasticnet_files/figure-html/obs-pred-1.png){width=528} ::: ::: ### Variable importance ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} en_fit |> extract_fit_parsnip() |> vip(num_features = 15, geom = "col", aesthetics = list(fill = house_pal[4])) + labs(title = "Elastic net — top coefficients") + theme_minimal() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Largest standardised coefficients at the tuned penalty.](06-elasticnet_files/figure-html/vip-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Save the fitted workflow ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} saveRDS(en_fit, file = here("models", "elasticnet_fit.rds")) ``` ::: ## Submission ```bash quarto render docs/submission.qmd -P model:elasticnet ``` ## Next steps - Continue to the **[SVM](07-svm.qmd)** and **[MARS](08-mars.qmd)** models. - Back to the **[master results table](../index.qmd)**.
